item.title: Dumbbell Workout for Beginners at Home: 6 Moves With One Pair of Weights
item.description: A dumbbell workout for beginners at home using just one pair of weights. Six full-body moves, sets and reps, how to choose a starting weight and what to avoid. Plan two or three short sessions a week. Guide contains affiliate links.
